name: What are popular design trends for modern guest bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What are popular design trends for modern guest bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular design trends for modern guest bathrooms include minimalist aesthetics with clean lines, floating vanities to enhance space, and a focus on natural materials like wood or stone accents. Large-format tiles create a seamless look, while strategically placed lighting can brighten the room. Smart storage solutions, water-efficient fixtures, and a subtle color palette often contribute to a sophisticated and welcoming guest experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular modern guest bathroom trends include minimalist designs, floating vanities, natural materials, large-format tiles, strategic lighting, and smart storage.
